correctness.rationale: Exact decomposition W ≅ ⊕_{b=0}^{m−1} r^b (I+aS)D_{r^m}; Jacobi closed-walk trace yields P_{k,a}(r^{2m})/(1−r^{2k}) for each k≥1. Squared-singular-value-weighted finite measures have all even moments converging on [0,1+a]; the displayed endpoint and interior measures have these moments and no positive atoms, proving pointwise counting. Perron positivity gives the strict norm interpolation. Standalone exact-rational checker passed 129 finite assertions; finite tests are not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The natural first two-tap extension of the recent monomial weighted-composition model couples columns and yields a genuine band/concentration crossover: full singular counting, exact all-even Schatten moment hierarchy, strictly changing spectral edge, and a noncommuting limiting fourth moment despite invariant leading Hilbert–Schmidt scaling.
